_: Make a custom dragon shout LEARNABLE. A SHOU + 3 WOOP is record-correct but UNUSABLE until the player learns its words at a word wall. This spec ships: (1) a custom shout 'Forged Voice' (3 Words of Power, each firing a progressively stronger Voice spell), and (2) a word wall in Bleak Falls Barrow that teaches its FIRST word — a WordWallTrigger activator placed in the barrow + a start-enabled teaching QUEST whose GENERATED Papyrus fragment calls Game.GetPlayer().AddShout(shout)+TeachWord(word). HONEST: the .psc is a compile-ready scaffold — the Creation Kit must compile it and the in-game learning is UNCONFIRMED (no Skyrim/Papyrus here). The blue word-glow VFX on the wall is a separate CK/mesh concern, not emitted. `package` writes Data/Scripts/Source/ForgedVoiceWordWallScript.psc for the CK. IMPORTANT (2026-06-01): learning is driven by the teaching QUEST fragment OnInit (start-game-enabled), so the shout + word 1 are granted AS SOON AS THE PLUGIN LOADS — NOT by walking to the wall. The placed WordWallTrigger is decorative; binding it to OnTriggerEnter for true walk-up learning is CK work. Also the placement targets cell 0x0371DE = the VANILLA Unrelenting Force wall room, so the wall you see there is VANILLA, not ours (ours sits at cell-origin 0,0,0) — do not confuse them. Shout now castable: Voice spells auto-get EitherHand EQUP.

magicEffects._: The effect each charge level fires — a simple stagger/force on the target. Voice cast, fire-and-forget aimed.
magicEffects.name: Forged Voice
magicEffects.description: A forged Thu'um hammers the target.

spells._: Word 1 (tap) — weakest. spellType=Voice so it's a shout charge level, not a normal spell. baseCost 0 (shouts cost no magicka).
spells.name: Forged Voice

wordsOfPower._: The dragon-language syllables. `name` is the glyph string shown in the shout menu; `translation` the gloss.
wordsOfPower.name: Dov

shouts._: The shout: exactly 3 words, each a WOOP `word` + the Voice SPEL `spell` that fires at that charge level + recoveryTime (cooldown seconds). word1=tap, 1+2=hold, 1+2+3=full charge.
shouts.name: Forged Voice
shouts.description: Dov Ah Vulom — a Thu'um forged in ModForge.

wordWalls._: The learnable layer. Teaches word 1 (MF_WordDov, auto-derived from the shout's wordIndex). Emits: a start-enabled teaching QUEST (editorId) hosting the generated fragment, and a WordWallTrigger activator (vanilla Skyrim.esm:0x05095E) placed in BleakFallsBarrow01 (0x0371DE) where the real Unrelenting Force wall is. The generated .psc (ForgedVoiceWordWallScript) AddShouts the shout + TeachWords the word on the player. `package` writes it to Scripts/Source for the CK to compile. position is cell-local; tweak in the CK to sit at the wall.
wordWalls.name: Forged Voice Word Wall
